unit_rules.name: The Dragon
unit_rules.text: Friendly +Shattered Legions+ units within 6" have !Feel No Pain 5+! against Mortal Damage. In addition, each time this model makes an attack with a weapon that has the +[Torrent]+ or +[Melta]+ keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Dragon
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit and not a +Leader+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
